scope: Oudezijds Voorburgwal east39–71 discovery row, six fixed primary current2025crops only; no exact photo-Pand mapping and no heldout inspection.
method: Direct tools.view_image inspection of all six municipal primary crops, six baseline photo-source-row images and cornice-upper/neck-middle/bell-lower block views. Source-only observations read before decisions; roof/palette hypotheses assessed independently.

criteria.observedRelationship: Narrow fronts carry separate broad2/3-column groups; taller lower/ground glazing, intermediate sash/transom windows and shorter attic openings. Pale outer surrounds remain readable around restrained dark muntins.
criteria.baselineFailure: Many fronts use extremely skinny multi-pane windows repeated evenly, with weak broad-to-narrow vertical hierarchy. Late-year-neck baseline has six thin columns across its central front, changing whole-front cadence rather than an exact count. Neck-middle and bell-lower substitute slender dense glazing for larger transom/sash openings.
criteria.capabilityGap: Source-coherent grouped frontage layout calibrated from complete exposed run, differentiated ground/upper/attic sizes and pale surround/dark-muntin hierarchy.
criteria.rejectCondition: Dense skinny repeated panes remain the dominant row grammar, upper groups become ribbon-like or the ground-to-attic opening hierarchy remains flattened.
criteria.secondaryLimits: Exact individual pane/column count and camera registration are secondary; gross group cadence and spacing are critical.

criteria.observedRelationship: Wide projecting pale flat cornices coexist with narrowed raised neck silhouettes and a shaped bell crest; bell-lower has visibly paired pale round/oval crown openings. Hoist beams connect to crown families.
criteria.baselineFailure: Central neck-middle shows angular/tall rectangular extensions or generic pitched caps; bell-lower lacks shaped bell crest and paired oculi. Cornice-upper includes a pale unsupported bridge-like gap beneath crowning strip. Broad facade-first roof family composition does not reproduce observed flat/neck/bell mixture.
criteria.capabilityGap: Shared source-admitted roof prior and compatible eaves/wall planning plus contained paired oculi; flat cornice assemblies must connect to wall top, not float over gaps.
criteria.rejectCondition: Generic attic rectangles replace paired oculi; row becomes predominantly generic triangular/rectangular crowns; roof/wall gaps, reversed plates, floaters or extra lids remain.
criteria.secondaryLimits: Exact curls/sculpture/crown-to-address assignment are secondary. Native height/footprint/courtyard invariants remain required.

criteria.observedRelationship: Dark brown/charcoal masonry and cream/white surrounds/cornices dominate. Pale rendered front with dark frames is a bounded visible exception; tan lintel/sill bands appear on other brick fronts.
criteria.baselineFailure: Neck-middle baseline favors bright reddish/orange masonry with dark green/red inner frames and repetitive pale string courses. Upper-unmatched central front is dark green, while pale rendered exception is not apparent in comparable group. Bell-lower dark wall color alone does not preserve pale surround/dark sash proportions.
criteria.capabilityGap: Joint material+outer-trim+inner-sash recipes admitted to observed frontage cohorts; retain pale rendered/dark-frame exception rather than uniform dark tint.
criteria.rejectCondition: Bright orange/red or green masonry dominates observed dark row; pale borders disappear into dark framing; exception is erased or expands across unrelated fronts.
criteria.secondaryLimits: Precise sampled RGB values and blue sky reflections are not facade facts. Palette alone cannot pass window/crown/ground criteria.

criteria.observedRelationship: Tall individual ground glazing beside side entrances alternates with broad commercial glass and pale surrounds. Raised stoops/iron rails align to actual entrance opening and elevated base; upper panes are smaller.
criteria.baselineFailure: Repeated stock fanlight doors with modest adjacent panes dominate. Neck-middle has some steps but disconnected ordinary window proportions; bell-lower becomes a generic full-width black awning/fascia shop instead of tall glazing and raised side entry. Cornice-upper ground detail lacks broad framed ground group.
criteria.capabilityGap: Connected raised-entry/tall-ground-glazing assembly and bounded commercial ground assembly, prioritised before optional props. Preserve genuine mapped shop identity separately from visual grammar.
criteria.rejectCondition: Every frontage uses the same standard door/window or fascia template; stoops do not meet a door; large ground panes and side entry relationship disappear.
criteria.secondaryLimits: Exact business labels, door panel decoration and stair count are secondary; do not add painted building names.

criteria.observedRelationship: Primary crops have window boxes, entry rails and one small ground canopy; no repeated open residential balcony stack on central sampled fronts.
criteria.baselineFailure: Upper-unmatched/cornice-related context shows incidental residential balcony stacks; block views contain generic window boxes and broad black awnings. These extras mix unsupported modern/ornamental priors into a row that derives rhythm from glazing/crowns/stoops. Exact ownership of peripheral stack-bearing front is unregistered, so do not claim a specific photographed building lacks it.
criteria.capabilityGap: Restrained architectural detail policy within admitted observed source class, excluding incidental balcony stacks while retaining sourced entry rails/window boxes/canopy only where compatible.
criteria.rejectCondition: Repeating balcony stacks spread into admitted primary group or optional props dominate/window-block supported assemblies; no unsupported gap/slab/awning is excused by palette improvement.
criteria.secondaryLimits: Do not generalize no-balcony claim citywide or to unobserved peripheral fronts.

rules: Freeze criteria and representative samples before recipe tuning; assign each cycle concrete shared-capability changes and preserve before/after failures.
Review broad row and obliques first, source-row details second; exact source registration, crown curls and individual opening counts cannot delay useful composition improvements.
Record each critical criterion pass/fail/uncertain every cycle;three completed cycles are effort history, not acceptance.

Use joint window/ground/crown/material recipe relationships on source-admitted exposed groups, not showcasedbuilding-ID dispatch overrides. Preserve factual years, footprint/nativeheight and explicit measured/tagged/curated geometry.
Freeze candidate before separately owned heldout acquisition/review. Failed heldout blocks affected transfer regardless of training gains.

Actual-game/mode/streaming and full-scene CPU/GPU evidence required after native visual pass; offline430neighbor ordinary stage excludes curated kit/GLB/shop overrides and cannot establish game completion.
